title: 第15章 两个外来人第16章 墨老与黄金狮子
content_zh:
“一株药？什么药？”张楚问。
老村长摇头：“这我哪里知道，我只是听老一辈说，咱们这附近，可能有一个恐怖的大坟。”
紧接着，老村长把自己知道的所有信息，都告诉了张楚：
“我听说，那个大坟，每隔六十年，都会孕生出一株特别的药。”
“而那些外来人和大妖，就是为了抢夺那株药。”
“至于那株药是什么，有什么用，多厉害，那不是咱们这种小村民能知道的。”
张楚顿时恍然：“原来是这样，怪不得，最近妖墟来了那么多外来人和大妖！”
老村长则急忙叮嘱道：“这件事，不要对其他人说，我怕有人不知道自己的斤两，去打那株药的主意，那会给咱们小村，带来灭顶之灾。”
张楚顿时点头：“放心，我相信，咱们村民没那么不知死活。”
此刻，张楚开始把所有的线索都串联起来。
妖墟的夜，污染，恐怖大坟，神秘的药，未来某一天，可能会一夜之间消失的污染……
张楚感觉，这其中，似乎蕴含着什么大秘密。
老村长则叹道：“先生，其实想那些没用，这妖墟的事，咱没办法控制，咱就是普通的村民，把吃的储存够，好好呆在村内就行。”
说到这里，老村长的目光变得悠远：“其实，真正的混乱，还没开始……”
张楚心中一跳：“真正的混乱，是什么样的？”
老村长说道：
“我记得，六十年前，曾经有大部族的人来到我们村，掳走了很多青壮，那些人再也没回来。”
“我还记得，曾经有小山那么大的妖，喋血在咱们村口！”
“可惜，那时候村里人很弱，连它的尸体都没办法接近，根本就吃不到肉。”
“也曾经有刀客，一刀把山峰劈成两半，巨大的滚石差点把咱们村埋葬。”

“还有一些外来的恶人，会强行进入村子，让村里的女人陪睡……”
“不过，咱们的枣树神，会保佑咱们，平安渡过。”
张楚听的心惊肉跳，他深吸了一口气：“如果咱们自己不变强，终归是听天由命。”
老村长则叹道：“哎，在妖墟，人命本来就不值钱。”
但紧接着，老村长又开心起来：“现在好了，自从先生来到我们枣叶村，村里已经很久没挨饿了。而且，孩子们，猎人队，也比以前强太多。”
张楚却觉得，这些还不够。
想要在妖墟安稳的生活下去，就要有保护自己的实力。
现在，童青山已经踏上了修炼之路，还得到了一味宝药，进入了闭关。
那么，其他人呢？
还有，张楚体内出现了一幅山海图，他的实力也在增强，那种躲在小村，苟活一辈子的想法，也渐渐消退。
现在，张楚也希望自己变强，有朝一日，或许能离开妖墟，尝尝其他地方的妖，是什么味道。
“一步步变强吧！”张楚心中想道。
接下来的一段时间，外界又开始混乱。
不断有外来人发生战斗，不过，他们似乎有一些特殊的约定，轻易不会打扰小村的安静。
枣叶村，所有人都在拼命的提升自己，妖凝膏的消耗越来越多。
每个人都憋了一股劲，希望能像童青山那样，结出妖丹。
而童青山则进入了一种特殊的状态，他竟然结出了一层厚厚的光茧，气息完全被遮掩了起来。
“先生，爹爹会不会饿啊？他都六天没吃肉了。”小葡萄眨着大眼睛，十分担心。
张楚则摸了摸小葡萄的脑袋：“不会的，青山是在突破，不用担心。”
“那爹爹要多久才能出来？”小葡萄问。

张楚沉吟道：“一般来说，最短要半个月，最长，可能要三个月。”
结茧，并非所有修炼者都会出现。
content_en:
"A medicine? What medicine?" Zhang Chu asked.
The old village chief shook his head: "How do I know this? I just heard from the older generation that there may be a terrifying big grave near us."
Immediately afterwards, the old village chief told Zhang Chu all the information he knew:
"I heard that that big tomb will give birth to a special medicine every sixty years."
"And those outsiders and big monsters are just trying to snatch that medicine."
"As for what that medicine is, what it is used for, and how powerful it is, that is not something that small villagers like us can know."
Zhang Chu suddenly realized: "So that's how it is. No wonder, so many outsiders and big monsters have come to the Demon Ruins recently!"
The old village chief hurriedly warned: "Don't tell other people about this. I'm afraid that if someone doesn't know their own worth and tries to take advantage of that medicine, it will bring disaster to our small village."
Zhang Chu nodded immediately: "Don't worry, I believe that our villagers are not that reckless."
At this moment, Zhang Chu began to connect all the clues.
The night of the demon ruins, pollution, the terrifying tomb, the mysterious medicine, the pollution that may disappear overnight one day in the future...
Zhang Chu felt that there seemed to be some big secret in it.
The old village chief sighed: "Sir, it's useless to think about it. We can't control what happens in this monster market. We are just ordinary villagers. We just need to store enough food and stay in the village."
At this point, the old village chief's eyes became distant: "Actually, the real chaos has not begun yet..."
Zhang Chu's heart skipped a beat: "What does real chaos look like?"
The old village chief said:
"I remember that sixty years ago, people from a large tribe came to our village and kidnapped many young people. Those people never came back."
"I still remember that there used to be a monster as big as a small mountain, bleeding at the entrance to our village!"
"It's a pity that the people in the village were so weak at that time that they couldn't even get close to its body and couldn't eat the meat at all."
"There was also a swordsman who split the mountain in half with one sword, and the huge rolling stone almost buried our village."
"There are also some evil people from outside who will forcefully enter the village and let the women in the village sleep with them..."
"However, our jujube tree god will protect us and make it through safely."
Zhang Chu was horrified when he heard this, and he took a deep breath: "If we don't become stronger, we will ultimately have to resign ourselves to fate."
The old village chief sighed: "Hey, in the Demon Ruins, human life is not valuable."
But then, the old village chief became happy again: "It's better now. Since Mr. came to our Zaoye Village, the village has not been hungry for a long time. Moreover, the children and the hunting team are much stronger than before."
Zhang Chu felt that these were not enough.
If you want to live a stable life in the Demon Ruins, you must have the strength to protect yourself.
Now, Tong Qingshan has embarked on the path of cultivation, obtained a precious medicine, and entered seclusion.
So, what about everyone else?
Also, a map of mountains and seas appeared in Zhang Chu's body, and his strength was also increasing. The idea of ​​hiding in a small village and surviving for a lifetime gradually faded away.
Now, Zhang Chu also hopes that he will become stronger. One day, he may be able to leave the demon ruins and taste the taste of demons in other places.
"Get stronger step by step!" Zhang Chu thought in his heart.
In the following period, the outside world began to be chaotic again.
There are constant fights between outsiders, but they seem to have some special agreements not to disturb the tranquility of the small village.
In Zaoye Village, everyone is working hard to improve themselves, and the consumption of Yaoning Cream is increasing.
Everyone was holding back their energy, hoping to be able to form a demon pill like Tong Qingshan.
Tong Qingshan entered a special state. He actually formed a thick cocoon of light, and his aura was completely covered.
"Sir, is Daddy hungry? He hasn't eaten meat for six days." Little Putao blinked his big eyes, very worried.Zhang Chu touched Little Putao's head: "No, Qingshan is making a breakthrough, don't worry."
"How long will it take for daddy to come out?" Little Putao asked.
Zhang Chu muttered: "Generally speaking, the shortest time is half a month, and the longest time is maybe three months."
Cocoon formation does not occur for all practitioners.
